main.description: Lists a community's owner and every moderator, from the social.coves.community.moderator records in the community's repository. Public; the list is not paginated and has no cap. Roles are served only in communities this instance hosts; for any other indexed community the roster is empty (no owner, no moderators).

community.description: The community, identified as social.coves.community.get accepts: DID, canonical handle, or scoped name

owner.description: The community's owner; absent when it has none

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No indexed community matches the identifier

roleView.description: One account's role in the community.
